description: Baseline permissions for a DevKit window. The sidecar is spawned from Rust, so no shell permissions are exposed to the frontend; the updater and a restart are, because installing a new version is asked for from the UI, and the three window permissions are what lets the inspector be opened in a window of its own. One entry per shape of app-window label: `main` is the one the config opens, `s1`, `s2`, … are the comparisons opened after it.
